text: Hi, sorry if this is silly. My sister is 2 months old and her temp is 38.9. Mum's in the bath. I noticed some little purpley marks on her legs, kind of like tiny bruises or someone dotted her with a pen. I think I remember you're meant to press a glass on rashes, so I tried and I could still see them through it, they didn't really go lighter. She hasn't had a fit or any shaking or jerking or anything. I'm not sure if it's something or if I'm being dramatic.
